assembly_instructions: Microarchitecture block diagram of the lowRISC Ibex RV32IMC core, not a physical machine — scale is abstract (1x, units treated as meters). Everything sits on a single black-composite backplane board (root) lying flat in the XZ plane with its top surface at y=0.3; there is deliberately NO enclosing chassis so every functional block stays visible. The pipeline reads left-to-right along +X. The IF stage occupies X < -1 (instruction-memory port, prefetch buffer, fetch unit, with the program counter and PC-increment adder on the +Z side row). The translucent glass pipeline register at X=-1 marks the single IF -> ID/EX stage boundary. The ID/EX stage occupies X > -1 (decoder, ALU, load-store unit, data-memory port on the central spine; RVC compressed decoder, register file, CSR block and external interrupt port on the +Z row; controller, branch-target calculation and multiplier/divider on the -Z row). The -Z row also carries the clock/reset port at X=-4.3 (IF side) and the PMP unit at X=4.7. Parallel side rows are placed at Z = +2.6/+2.7 and Z = -2.6. The integer ALU is modelled as a carrier plate holding three exposed execution sub-units (adder, shifter, logic/compare) so its interior is legible. The register file's interior is exposed as a four-plate exploded stack lifted directly above the file. Copper cylinders are the datapath buses connecting block faces: X-aligned buses use rotation [0,0,1.5708], Z-aligned buses use rotation [1.5708,0,0]. The instruction-side PMP check is routed as a thinner copper bus along the back channel at Z=-3.95 from the PMP unit to the instruction-memory port. Build the board first, then the spine blocks, then the +Z and -Z side rows, then the ALU sub-units and exploded register stack, then the buses last.

info.summary: Ibex is a small, 2-stage in-order 32-bit RISC-V CPU core maintained by lowRISC, designed for embedded control and security applications. It implements the RV32IMC instruction set and is the root-of-trust processor in the OpenTitan project.
info.description: Ibex (formerly 'Zero-riscy' from ETH Zurich's PULP platform) is a production-quality open-source RISC-V core written in SystemVerilog. Its pipeline has just two stages: an Instruction Fetch (IF) stage with a FIFO prefetch buffer that decouples fetch from memory latency, and a combined Instruction Decode / Execute (ID/EX) stage that performs decode, register read, ALU execution, multiply/divide, CSR access and load/store in program order. The decoder also expands compressed (RVC) 16-bit instructions. The architecture is highly configurable: the M (multiply/divide) extension can be a fast single-cycle multiplier or an area-optimized multi-cycle unit, and security-hardened variants add dual-core lockstep and ECC. Ibex achieves roughly 2.4 CoreMark/MHz in its baseline configuration and is released under the permissive Apache-2.0 license.
info.contractor: lowRISC C.I.C. (original 'Zero-riscy' design by ETH Zurich / University of Bologna PULP team)

facts.label: Interrupts
facts.value: Standard + up to 15 fast local IRQs

parts.name: Backplane Board
parts.role: Root substrate that carries and visually anchors every functional block of the block diagram.

parts.name: Instruction-Memory Interface Port
parts.role: 32-bit instruction-side memory port — issues fetch addresses and receives instruction words from the I-bus.

parts.name: Prefetch Buffer (FIFO)
parts.role: FIFO that decouples instruction fetch from memory latency, supplying the fetch unit with a steady instruction stream.

parts.name: Instruction Fetch Unit
parts.role: Selects the next program-counter value and aligns compressed (RVC) and uncompressed instructions before the pipeline register.

parts.name: Program Counter
parts.role: Register holding the address of the instruction currently in the IF stage.

parts.name: PC Increment Adder
parts.role: Computes PC+2 / PC+4 for sequential instruction fetch.

parts.name: IF -> ID/EX Pipeline Register
parts.role: Latches the fetched instruction and PC at the single pipeline-stage boundary of Ibex's 2-stage design.

parts.name: Instruction Decoder
parts.role: Produces register addresses, immediates, ALU operation and control signals for the ID/EX stage from the registered instruction word.

parts.name: Compressed (RVC) Instruction Decoder
parts.role: Expands 16-bit RVC compressed instructions into their 32-bit base-ISA equivalents before main decode.

parts.name: ID/EX Controller FSM
parts.role: Sequences multi-cycle operations, pipeline stalls, flushes and exception/interrupt entry.

parts.name: RISC-V Debug Module Interface
parts.role: Injects debug-mode entry and single-step control into the fetch and controller logic.

parts.name: Clock / Reset & Gating Port
parts.role: Receives clk_i and rst_ni and drives the integrated clock-gating cell that stalls the prefetch buffer to save power when fetch is idle.

parts.name: 32 x 32-bit Register File
parts.role: General-purpose register file with two read ports and one write port; register x0 is hard-wired to zero.

parts.name: Register Bank Plate 1 (x0–x7)
parts.role: Exploded view: representative bank of eight 32-bit registers lifted above the file to expose the array interior.

parts.name: Register Bank Plate 2 (x8–x15)
parts.role: Exploded view: representative bank of eight 32-bit registers, second plate of the lifted register-file stack.

parts.name: Register Bank Plate 3 (x16–x23)
parts.role: Exploded view: representative bank of eight 32-bit registers, third plate of the lifted register-file stack.

parts.name: Register Bank Plate 4 (x24–x31)
parts.role: Exploded view: representative bank of eight 32-bit registers, top plate of the lifted register-file stack.

parts.name: Integer ALU Carrier
parts.role: Carrier plate for the integer execution sub-units — routes decoded operands to the adder, shifter and logic/compare blocks and returns the selected result onto the datapath.

parts.name: ALU Adder / Subtractor
parts.role: Single-cycle add/subtract unit that also computes effective addresses and branch comparisons' difference.

parts.name: ALU Barrel Shifter
parts.role: Single-cycle barrel shifter performing logical and arithmetic left/right shifts.

parts.name: ALU Logic / Comparator
parts.role: Bitwise AND/OR/XOR logic and signed/unsigned comparison unit feeding branch-condition resolution.

parts.name: Multiplier / Divider
parts.role: Implements the RV32M extension — multi-cycle multiply and iterative divide.

parts.name: CSR (Control & Status Registers)
parts.role: Holds machine-mode control/status registers and handles trap, interrupt and exception entry and return.

parts.name: External Interrupt Interface Port
parts.role: Receives the external/timer/software and up to 15 fast local interrupt request lines and presents them to the CSR interrupt registers.

parts.name: Branch Target Calculation
parts.role: Computes branch/jump target addresses and resolves taken branches, feeding the next-PC selection.

parts.name: Load-Store Unit
parts.role: Generates data-memory addresses and handles byte/halfword/word alignment and misaligned-access splitting.

parts.name: Physical Memory Protection Unit
parts.role: Checks every load/store and instruction-fetch address against up to 16 configurable PMP regions and raises an access fault on a violation.

parts.name: Data-Memory Interface Port
parts.role: 32-bit data-side memory port — drives load and store transactions onto the D-bus.

parts.name: Instruction Bus: I-Port -> Prefetch
parts.role: Carries fetched instruction words from the instruction-memory port into the prefetch buffer.

parts.name: Instruction Bus: Prefetch -> Fetch
parts.role: Feeds buffered instructions from the FIFO into the fetch/alignment unit.

parts.name: Instruction Bus: Fetch -> Pipeline Register
parts.role: Latches the aligned instruction and PC into the IF -> ID/EX pipeline register.

parts.name: Instruction Bus: Pipeline Register -> Decoder
parts.role: Delivers the registered instruction word to the decoder in the ID/EX stage.

parts.name: Bus: RVC Decoder -> Instruction Decoder
parts.role: Carries the RVC-expanded 32-bit instruction from the compressed decoder into the main instruction decoder.

parts.name: Control Bus: Decoder -> ALU
parts.role: Carries the decoded ALU operation and immediate operand to the integer ALU carrier.

parts.name: Address Bus: ALU -> Load-Store Unit
parts.role: Passes computed effective addresses from the ALU to the load-store unit.

parts.name: Data Bus: Load-Store Unit -> D-Port
parts.role: Carries load/store data and addresses between the load-store unit and the data-memory port.

parts.name: Bus: Load-Store Unit -> PMP Unit
parts.role: Routes each data-access address from the load-store unit to the PMP unit and returns the access-grant or fault result.

parts.name: Clock Bus: Clock Port -> Prefetch Buffer
parts.role: Distributes the gated clock from the clock/reset port to the prefetch buffer FIFO.

parts.name: Next-PC Bus: Increment -> Program Counter
parts.role: Feeds the incremented address back into the program counter for sequential fetch.

parts.name: PC Bus: Program Counter -> Fetch
parts.role: Supplies the current program-counter value to the fetch unit's address generation.

parts.name: Control Bus: Debug Interface -> Fetch Unit
parts.role: Carries debug-mode entry and single-step requests from the debug interface into the fetch unit.

parts.name: Control Bus: Controller -> Pipeline Register
parts.role: Routes stall, flush and valid signals between the controller FSM and the IF -> ID/EX pipeline register.

parts.name: Operand Bus: Register File rs1 -> ALU
parts.role: Carries the first source operand from register-file read port A into the ALU.

parts.name: Operand Bus: Register File rs2 -> ALU
parts.role: Carries the second source operand from register-file read port B into the ALU.

parts.name: Writeback Bus: ALU -> Register File
parts.role: Returns the ALU/load result to the register file's single write port to complete the datapath loop.

parts.name: Operand Bus: ALU -> Multiplier/Divider
parts.role: Shares operands and returns multi-cycle results between the ALU datapath and the multiply/divide unit.

parts.name: Bus: Decoder -> Branch Target Calc
parts.role: Delivers branch immediates and the PC to the branch-target calculation unit.

parts.name: Bus: Load-Store Unit -> CSR Block
parts.role: Routes CSR read/write traffic and trap status between the execute path and the CSR block.

parts.name: Interrupt Bus: IRQ Port -> CSR Block
parts.role: Carries the external interrupt request lines from the interrupt port into the CSR interrupt-pending registers.

parts.name: Instruction-PMP Bus: PMP Unit Drop
parts.role: Short jog dropping the instruction-fetch PMP check path from the PMP unit onto the rear routing channel.

parts.name: Instruction-PMP Bus: Rear Routing Channel
parts.role: Rear-channel bus carrying instruction-fetch addresses from the PMP unit toward the instruction-memory port for region checking.

parts.name: Instruction-PMP Bus: Into I-Port
parts.role: Returns the instruction-fetch access-grant or fault result from the PMP routing channel into the instruction-memory port.
